messages:
ellie: Posted the postmortem for the outage at 14:03 UTC. We need a decision on what to publish to status.redwood.com and when.

maria: Thanks — reading now. Are we aligning on: initial customer-facing summary within 24h, and full RCA within 7 days?

priya: +1 on timelines but prefer 48h for a meaningful initial update unless there's a simple mitigation to announce. Also we should avoid technical blame and keep the public summary action-focused.

sam: Policy recap: engineering proposed 24-48h initial note, 7 business days for full RCA. For high-impact customers we proactively offer an embargoed summary.

james: Noted a recurring pattern here: autoscaler + KV cache eviction causing increased tail latency. We should call that out internally and track as a recurring-incident class.

ellie: For status page copy, draft below — please iterate: 
```
We experienced increased API latency affecting a subset of requests between 13:50–14:05 UTC. Root cause: autoscaling behavior triggered unexpected cache evictions that increased downstream processing time. Mitigation: we rolled back the scaling change and applied a cache warm-up; services restored by 14:25 UTC. Ongoing actions: follow-up engineering changes to autoscaler heuristics and cache persistence.
```

maria: That draft is pretty detailed — maybe trim slightly for public: remove 'cache evictions' term and say 'internal cache event' to avoid exposing infra details.

priya: We also need a sentence about customer impact and next steps for customers: 'If you were impacted, contact support@redwood.com for a tailored summary.'

sam: Agreed. Suggested public copy (short): 
```
Between 13:50–14:25 UTC we experienced increased API latency impacting some requests. We restored service after mitigating an internal autoscaling issue. We're investigating root cause and will publish a full RCA within 7 business days. If you need immediate details, contact support@redwood.com.
```

james: Action items: 
- AI-#214 assign sam: create statuspage update by EOD (48h) 
- AI-#215 assign priya: prepare redacted postmortem for public link (7d) 
- AI-#216 assign eng-runtime: implement autoscaler metric gate (owner: james, 2w)

ellie: Please add owners in the ticket descriptions and set realistic SLAs. Also decide whether to post full RCA publicly or only provide on request.

maria: My take: post a redacted RCA publicly to be transparent; include a link to request full details for vetted customers. Helps trust and reduces support load. :+1:

priya: Agree but redact internal IPs, employee IDs, and exact rollout timestamps for safety/regulatory reasons.

sam: I'll flag compliance for review on the redacted version. @james can you own the public redaction checklist?

james: I can. I'll add a checklist item in AI-#215 for compliance review and redact fields.

incident-bot: New task created: AI-#214, AI-#215, AI-#216.

ellie: Great — let's reconvene in 48h to verify the statuspage draft goes live and confirm the 7-day RCA timeline.

maria: Sounds good.

priya: Thanks everyone — I'll start the redaction pass.

sam: I'll ping affected customers with an offer for tailored summaries.

ellie: Closing notes: owners = sam, priya, james; check-ins scheduled. I'll post a short summary to #customer-success once status copy is live.
